Hi Sam / Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Attached is the draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) we discussed. I pulled out the milestones, owners, and dependencies so we can get aligned on the target close and procurement timing. Key highlights: 

- Target close (commercial signature): 2026-04-20 (proposed)
- Procurement contract signature target: 2026-04-15 (FintechCo needs to route to procurement/legal)
- Milestones: POC kickoff, technical review, security questionnaire responses, procurement/contract review, signature
- Owners: Redwood (Marissa/Rishi) for POC and technical onboarding; FintechCo (Samantha/Procurement) for contract review and PO issuance

Please review the attached MAP and let me know if any dates or owners need to shift. My ask: can procurement commit to a signature-by date so we can lock the Q2 rollout?

Attachments: MAP-Redwood-FintechCo-v2.xlsx (MAP draft), POC-scope.pdf

Next steps I propose:
1) FintechCo confirms procurement/legal signature deadline
2) We finalize MAP and update HubSpot (link below)
3) Schedule 30-min legal touchpoint if needed to unblock contract redlines
